title: REQ · A failed resume marks the execution RECOVERING with the error
summary: When Resume errors, the execution is saved as RECOVERING so an admin can retry or recover it.
description: Context: the Round lifecycle defines a RECOVERING state but store has no such status. Desired behavior: add store.StatusRecovering and have Recover persist it with the error text and clock time when Resume fails, then continue with the next execution. Expected result: Result lists marked IDs. Why: failures must be visible, not silently dropped.
acceptance_criteria: Given Resume returns an error for one execution, When Recover runs, Then the store receives that execution with Status RECOVERING, Error equal to the error text and UpdatedAt equal to the injected clock
Given the first of two executions fails to resume, When Recover runs, Then the second is still resumed
Given Save of the RECOVERING record fails, When Recover runs, Then Recover returns an error wrapping it
technical_constraints: StatusRecovering value is the string RECOVERING
definition_of_done: Constant added and used by Recover
